title: Stop Steam Input from triggering PCSX2 hotkeys during play
summary: Isolate controller events from Steam’s desktop layout, then verify that buttons reach the PS2 game without opening the emulator menu or pausing unexpectedly.
heroAlt: Top view of a Steam Controller with two trackpads.
author: EmuCore - Hub

blocks.text: A controller can work in a PS2 game and still send extra keyboard events through Steam’s desktop layout. PCSX2 documents two recognizable symptoms: Circle pauses the game and Start opens the Big Picture pause menu. These symptoms point to an input-layer collision, not automatically to a bad PS2 mapping.

Record the current Steam and emulator hotkey settings before changing them. Choose a harmless game menu, close unrelated controller software, and test one button at a time. Change only one Steam or PCSX2 layer per trial so the source of the extra event remains clear.

items: 1. Confirm the game controller works from PCSX2’s own controller settings before changing Steam.
2. Fully exit Steam from its system-tray menu and launch the game again as a baseline test.
3. If the problem stops, re-open Steam and disable its controller support for PCSX2, then repeat the same button test.
4. If Steam support is needed, edit the controller’s Desktop Layout to remove keyboard bindings that collide with the emulator hotkeys.
5. Alternatively, change the PCSX2 hotkey to a key not present in that Desktop Layout.
6. Test Circle, Start, pause, and resume separately; verify each intended action occurs once.

blocks.text: The test passes when a short repeatable sequence no longer pauses on Circle or opens a PCSX2 menu on Start, while the in-game Circle and Start actions still work. Retest after restarting both Steam and PCSX2 because Steam may reload its Desktop Layout when it starts.

items: Circle still pauses after Steam exits: inspect the PCSX2 hotkey assignment or another controller mapper.
Buttons work only with Steam closed: restore Steam, then adjust one Desktop Layout binding rather than deleting the whole layout.
One press triggers two actions: search for a duplicate keyboard mapping in Steam and PCSX2.
Big Picture opens unexpectedly: check Start’s desktop shortcut and the emulator pause-menu hotkey.

blocks.text: Restore the recorded Desktop Layout and hotkey values one at a time. Keep Steam controller support disabled only if the baseline established that it caused the extra keyboard event. Launch a game and verify normal button behavior before resuming play.
